𝗠𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗕𝘂𝘆𝗲𝗿𝘀 𝗗𝗼 𝗧𝗵𝗶𝘀… 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗥𝗲𝗴𝗿𝗲𝘁 𝗜𝘁 😬🏡 

Central Texas (Killeen • Harker Heights • Fort Hood) buyers 👇 
They follow the inspector around… nod at everything… 
then read the report later like 🤯 “wait… what does this even mean?” 

🚫 𝗗𝗼𝗻’𝘁 𝗯𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗯𝘂𝘆𝗲𝗿. 
Ask THESE before they leave 👇 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 

① 💸 “𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝟯 𝗺𝗼𝘀𝘁 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗶𝘀𝘀𝘂𝗲𝘀?” 
Reports list 30–50 items… but not all cost $$$ 

+ “If YOU were buying this home?” 
+ “Repair… or replace?” 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 

② ⏳ “𝗛𝗼𝘄 𝗺𝘂𝗰𝗵 𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗲 𝗶𝘀 𝗹𝗲𝗳𝘁 𝗶𝗻 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗺𝗮𝗷𝗼𝗿 𝘀𝘆𝘀𝘁𝗲𝗺𝘀?” 
(Roof • HVAC • Water Heater • Appliances) 

+ “End-of-life soon or just older?” 
+ “What should I budget in 1–5 years?” 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 

③ 💧 “𝗗𝗼 𝘆𝗼𝘂 𝘀𝗲𝗲 𝗮𝗻𝘆 𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝘀 𝗼𝗳 𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗶𝗻𝘁𝗿𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻?” 

Water issues = hidden $$$ 

+ “Where are the clues?” 
+ “What’s the likely source?” 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 

④ 🛠 “𝗪𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗱𝘀 𝗮 𝘀𝗽𝗲𝗰𝗶𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗕𝗘𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗘 𝗜 𝗰𝗹𝗼𝘀𝗲?” 

Inspectors = generalists 👀 

+ “Who would YOU call?” 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 

✨ 𝗣𝗥𝗢 𝗧𝗜𝗣𝗦 
• 📱 Record the inspector’s summary 
• 🧠 Ask: “Safety / Maintenance / Negotiation?” → instant clarity 

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
